propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same identity live and retired, which is detectable and safely completable but violates read-only operations if repaired at construction or preview time.

Incomplete-operation recovery must be extracted behind the facade and invoked from reconcile.py after the under-lock staleness gate but before the first remote issue fetch, requiring exact local id and Jira key agreement across tombstone, forward, and reverse entries.

The tombstone is the authoritative retirement intent; explicit unretire removes it and prevents completion, while automatic 200/clear_absent/same-key confirm does not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity.
apply_handlers.py must replace its mutation-through-all_bindings() call with the narrow rich-emission facade operation, and no production code shall mutate bindings through all_bindings().
Repeating completion is a no-op; any tombstone/forward/reverse mismatch, corrupt live file, or replace failure leaves recoverable evidence and safety-aborts without unrelated mutation.
Construction, load, reconcile-check, dry-run, preview, selection, and filtered operations must remain zero-write for the retirement-completion operation.
